title: Vehicle Purchase Agreements: Deal Types, Entry Requirements and Reservation Hold Schedule
content:
Kessler Automotive Group writes every vehicle sale as one of six deal types of the **Vehicle Purchase Agreements**. Which deal type a sale is written under depends on who the buyer is and what vehicle is sold. The deal type then fixes the hold, extension and reservation-count figures below.

## Deal types and who may enter them

| Deal type | Buyer | Vehicle |
|---|---|---|
| Value Line Used Vehicle Purchase | an individual | a used vehicle at least 8 model years old, or one with at least 100000 odometer miles |
| Used Vehicle Retail Purchase | an individual | a used vehicle no more than 10 model years old and with no more than 120000 odometer miles |
| Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Purchase | an individual | a certified pre-owned vehicle that has passed the manufacturer's certification inspection |
| New Vehicle Retail Purchase | an individual | a new vehicle in dealer stock or in transit |
| New Vehicle Factory Order Purchase | an individual | a new vehicle ordered from a factory build slot |
| Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement | a fleet business | a new vehicle, with the manufacturer fleet account number on file |

## Reservation hold schedule

| Deal type | Hold placed only with a deposit received the same day | Hold length (calendar days, reservation date is day 0) | Days one hold extension adds to the current hold expiry date | Most hold extensions per deal | Most deals of this type one customer may have in reserved status at once |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Value Line Used Vehicle Purchase | yes | 2 | 2 | 1 | 1 |
| Used Vehicle Retail Purchase | yes | 3 | 2 | 1 | 2 |
| Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Purchase | yes | 3 | 3 | 1 | 2 |
| New Vehicle Retail Purchase | yes | 5 | 3 | 2 | 2 |
| New Vehicle Factory Order Purchase | yes | 120 | 30 | 2 | 2 |
| Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement | yes | 14 | 7 | 2 | 25 |

### Reading the schedule
- **Hold length.** The reservation date counts as day 0. A New Vehicle Retail Purchase reserved on a hypothetical 3rd of a month is held through the 8th, which is the reservation date plus 5 calendar days.
- **Extension days.** The extension figure is a number of calendar days added to the hold expiry date currently on the deal. It is never added to the date of the request.
- **Reservation count.** The count covers deals of the same deal type in reserved status only. Hypothetical example: a customer with 2 Used Vehicle Retail Purchase deals already in reserved status is at that deal type's figure of 2. The same customer's reserved Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Purchase deals are counted against their own figure.
- **Deposit with the hold.** For every deal type a hold is placed only together with a deposit received on the reservation date.
